answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 31951 Country: India Title: My brother is a Bums doctor. He has a son and wife to support his family. He runs his own private clinic. Question: My brother is a Bums doctor. He has a son and wife to support his family. He runs his own private clinic. Unfortunately even after seeking a job he doesn't have much income to support his family. So I request you on his behalf to kindly tell of some dua that would bring about a better income for his family and that his clinic would start to operate successfully. Answer ID: 31951 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 931/607/H=1432) Recite Surah al-Quraish (لایلاف قریش) 3 times after each salah with durood 3-3 times before and after. Also, do the same in the night and sleep on clean bed with wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
